title: Safe, verified security assessment
intro: A named, versioned checklist of non-destructive checks — TLS, security headers, mail authentication, known-vulnerability correlation and more — run against a domain you have verified. Every check passes, reports the evidence that failed it, or clearly says when a required observation could not be completed. No exploitation, ever.
notVerifiedBody: Assessment runs only on domains your organization has verified.
tlsCertificateRationale: An expired or soon-to-expire certificate breaks trust and can take a service offline.
tlsCertificateRemediation: Renew before expiry and automate renewal (e.g. ACME).
httpSecurityHeadersRationale: Missing baseline headers (HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, frame protection) weaken defence in depth.
httpSecurityHeadersRemediation: Add the missing response headers on the primary web surface.
transportDowngradeRationale: A redirect from HTTPS to HTTP exposes traffic to interception.
transportDowngradeRemediation: Serve HTTPS end to end and enable HSTS.
mailAuthenticationRationale: Absent mail-authentication records make the domain easy to spoof in phishing.
mailAuthenticationRemediation: Publish SPF and a DMARC policy; sign mail with DKIM. Start DMARC at p=none and monitor.
knownVulnerabilityCorrelationRationale: A disclosed technology version matched against a curated CVE set (enriched with CISA KEV / EPSS) is an item to confirm and patch — never a confirmed exploit.
knownVulnerabilityCorrelationRemediation: Confirm the version and patch or upgrade the affected technology.
exposedServicesRationale: Databases, admin panels or remote-access services reachable from the internet expand the attack surface.
exposedServicesRemediation: Restrict exposure to known networks, require authentication, or move behind a VPN.
authenticationSurfaceRationale: Public login and admin surfaces are natural credential-attack targets and should be minimised and hardened.
authenticationSurfaceRemediation: Confirm the surface should be public; enforce MFA, rate limiting and monitoring.
nonProductionExposureRationale: Staging and test environments often carry weaker controls and debug surfaces not intended for the public.
nonProductionExposureRemediation: Restrict to an allowlist/VPN or remove the public exposure.
shadowAssetsRationale: Unmanaged public assets may lack current ownership, patching or monitoring.
shadowAssetsRemediation: Confirm ownership and purpose; decommission if no longer needed.
infrastructureConcentrationTitle: Infrastructure concentration / single points of failure
infrastructureConcentrationRationale: Heavy reliance on one provider, nameserver or address concentrates blast radius.
infrastructureConcentrationRemediation: Review whether critical dependencies warrant redundancy.
domainRegistrationRationale: A lapsing domain registration risks loss of the domain and dependent services.
domainRegistrationRemediation: Renew the registration and enable auto-renew and registrar lock.
